recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-34303 unless a separate current-build duplicate report identifies a different code or generated artifact.
issue_request: FHIR-34303 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction raised against R4B downloads. It reported duplicate Resource, DomainResource, and Parameters concepts in the http://hl7.org/fhir/CodeSystem/resource-types entry from valuesets.json and the R4B code system page.
initial_application: No local git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-34303. Jira comments state the issue was pre-applied in R4B and R5 and later seemed fixed; the checked-in R4B release-history valuesets.xml now has one Resource, one DomainResource, and one Parameters concept in CodeSystem/resource-types.
additional_context: R5/current source no longer carries the old CodeSystem/resource-types shape. FHIR-32069 later introduced the generated fhir-types code system and ResourceTypes/AllResourceTypes value sets, separating concrete resource types from all resource types. Community searches found no Zulip or Confluence evidence contradicting the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current source inputs list the reported infrastructure resource codes once, R4B release history is duplicate-free for those codes, and R5 release history has no CodeSystem/resource-types while its replacement CodeSystem/fhir-types is duplicate-free.

related_jiras.note: Published R5 terminology refactor removed abstract types from the ResourceType code system and introduced the current fhir-types/value-set model, explaining why current source no longer has the old duplicate-prone CodeSystem/resource-types shape.
